    {
      "id": "3",

      "text": "Iterates over each byte in the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],

    {
      "id": "4",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Performs a loop of 8 iterations for each byte.",
      "asserted_values": [],

    },
    {
      "id": "5",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Writes the final checksum to the output buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "6",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the final checksum as a 64-bit unsigned integer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_01(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0xffffffff;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h ^= in[i];\n    for (uint8_t b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n      h = -(h & 1) & 0xedb88320 ^ h >> 1;\n    }\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)~h;\n}"
